sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We welcome your proposal for a 24-month contract, which reflects the mutual trust built over our 12-year partnership. 

For our current offer, we propose a price of €52.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. However, as a family-run foundry, extending payment terms to 60 days is not feasible for us. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €51.90 per unit, with a price of €51.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.

Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us. Please note that this proposal stays valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. Our longstanding relationship with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH is something we value deeply here at our foundry.

Regarding your request for a cost breakdown, as a privately held family business, we do not share detailed internal cost structures. Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us.

Please note that our offer remains a price of €52.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Our offer of €52.30 for 60-day payment terms remains on the table. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

We appreciate your understanding and look forward to continuing our cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
